title: Review fixes of #1026: notes dated by the plugin's clock, Chinese quotes kept, no note rewritten without the customer's words, a separator in a note's text, the build tool of an open build, dryRun only for content.replace, read keeps dsh's line cap, EmDash picture undo by the whole value
steps: S1: No stand, no browser, no model. Work in the TCH checkout at the commit under test, with its dependencies installed (pnpm install) and the deepseek-harness submodule initialised.

S2: From the checkout root run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/site-notes.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/site-notes-wiring.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/deferred-tools.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/prefix-stability.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/receipt-echo.test.mjs packages/site/tracy-site-tabs/test/turn-open-hold.test.mjs scripts/test/file-tool-caps.test.mjs — keep the 'ok'/'not ok' lines and the exit code.
expect: S2: every test named in run.tests reports ok, on any day (the wiring test sets the plugin's clock to 08/10/2026 and the kept note carries that date, not the real one).
A Chinese or Japanese quote counts as said when it holds at least 4 of its unspaced characters and is copied from the message; one or two words are not a quote.

An update or a remove whose said is missing, empty, too short, invented or taken from the old note is refused NOT_SAID and the note stays as it was; an update that quotes this message replaces the note's text and its quote.
A note whose text holds ' — said: "' reads back from the file whole, with its quote unchanged.

On a WordPress site whose build is running, waiting, paused or failed, a new conversation is sent tracy_site_build_wordpress from its first step; with no build on record or a build done it waits as before; the design tools and the other platform's build tool stay hidden.

A tracy_site call with dryRun:true (in params or top level) is a look only for content.replace; theme.activate, extension.enable, theme.style, media.draw, db.rollback, template.siteSettings and content.update with dryRun still wait for the seal and count as changing the site.
No preset of either bundle sets readMaxLineLength, readMaxBytes or readLimit on tool-fs.

An EmDash content_update receipt shows a picture as its short view; a changed picture restores the live revision when there is one, otherwise the undo by value carries the whole old picture in undoData; an unchanged picture beside a short change forces no restore.

selectors.notes: packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/src/host/site-notes.mjs (quoteIsSaid, applyNote update, LINE); src/host/index.ts captureWishes now
selectors.deferral: packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/src/host/deferred-tools.mjs toolsToDefer keepRoads; site-context.mjs siteBuildOpen; index.ts agent/created

evidence: Review of PR #1026 (09/10/2026): the wiring test was red on any day but 08/10 because captureWishes ignored config.now; probes showed a Chinese quote refused NOT_SAID, an update with no said rewriting n1 to any text, 'Use the slogan — said: "hi" always' parsed back cut, callMayWriteSite answering false for theme.activate with dryRun, the build tool hidden on a site whose build failed, and an EmDash undo by value writing mediaView's subset. Each test here fails on the commit before its fix.
fence: Mechanism only: what the host stores, defers, holds and writes in the receipt. Not covered: whether a model then calls the build tool or quotes the customer well (a bench measure).

tests: 🔒 a wish the customer typed is kept by the host, then sent once to the next message and the next conversation
a quote in a script written without spaces is measured in characters, and still must be typed
an op not tied to this message is refused NOT_SAID: update, said missing
an op not tied to this message is refused NOT_SAID: update, said empty
an op not tied to this message is refused NOT_SAID: update, said from the old note, not this message
an op not tied to this message is refused NOT_SAID: remove, said missing
update rewords a note only on the customer's words in this message
a note whose text holds the line separator reads back exactly as written
capture: a Chinese wish is kept on its own characters; an update with no words of this message is dropped
a road kept open keeps its tools from the first step
the build is open while it runs, waits, pauses or failed
🔒 on dsh’s own registry: a new conversation on a site whose build is open is sent its build tool from the first step
🔒 T-D: once the agent is made, nothing re-registers
callMayWriteSite and callChangedSite: a dryRun is a look only for content.replace
read keeps dsh's own caps in every preset
emdash picture undo: a changed picture, with a live revision: restore it
emdash picture undo: a changed picture, no live revision: by value, with the whole old picture
emdash picture undo: a picture removed, no live revision
emdash picture undo: a picture added where there was none
emdash picture undo: an unchanged picture beside a short change
